subject: Pricing: committed-use & startup discount follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing: committed-use & startup discount follow-up

Hi Samir  great to meet today, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Call recap:
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for real-time summarization + customer search reranking across product and support flows.
- Expected token profile: ~40 tokens/query average, bursty daytime traffic.
- Projected Q3 monthly usage: 300M800M tokens (conservative/target ranges you mentioned).
- Latency SLO: P95 < 150ms for production endpoints.

Budget & pricing signals you gave during the call:
- Internal budget range: $3k3$10k/month initially, with runway to expand if unit economics make sense.
- Leadership is targeting ~ $8001,200 per 1M tokens (net) for model + infra to hit their unit cost targets.

What I need to confirm so we can get you a formal proposal:
1) A target committed-use size (e.g., 6/12/24-month term) you'd be comfortable with if we can meet the net $/1M token target.
2) Whether Novaflow is eligible for our Startup Program (we'll need company stage & YC/accelerator info if applicable).
3) Any procurement requirements (PO process, SSO, required security docs).

Next steps (proposed):
- I will run the unit-economics back-of-envelope for 3 committed tiers (250M/mo, 500M/mo, 1B/mo) and show net $/1M tokens with committed-use discounts + startup credits where applicable.
- Deliver a short proposal + one-page pricing worksheet by EOD Thu (Apr 22).
- Tentative follow-up call Fri Apr 23 to review and lock in preferred tier.

Attaching: usage-estimates-2027.csv (your projected monthly scenarios)  please confirm numbers if anything is off.

Thanks  looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
Cell: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: usage-estimates-2027.csv (CSV, 14KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: committed-use & startup discount follow-up

Hi Marissa  thanks for the recap, that matches our notes. Couple clarifications: 
- The 300M800M/month range is where we'd be able to commit once we see the net unit cost; leadership has sign-off authority up to $10k/mo as-is.
- If we can get net pricing near $1,000 / 1M tokens, we can push for a 12-month committed baseline (likely ~500M/mo) with quarterly review for upsell.
- We are a Seed-stage company (raised a pre-seed + seed round)  happy to share the investor/accelerator details for the Startup Program.

Procurement: PO and a standard SOW are expected; SSO via Okta and basic SOC2 evidence is required. We'll coordinate procurement during the legal review.

Thanks  send over the proposal and we'll try to have procurement/finance join the Friday call if needed.

Cheers,
Samir
Samir Patel | VP Product, Novaflow
samir@novaflow.ai
Phone: +1 617-555-0134

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: committed-use & startup discount follow-up

Samir  appreciate the clarity. Attached is a one-page proposal and the pricing worksheet with the committed-tier math. Highlights below so procurement has the quick takeaways: 

Summary pricing (net $/1M tokens after discounts & startup credit assumptions):
- 6-month term / 250M/mo committed: list $1,450 -> net $1,250 / 1M tokens (includes 5% committed discount + startup promo of $10k credit applied month 1).
- 12-month term / 500M/mo committed: list $1,400 -> net $1,000 / 1M tokens (12% committed discount + startup program credit amortized).
- 24-month term / 1B/mo committed: list $1,300 -> net $900 / 1M tokens (18% committed + multi-year incentive + priority capacity).

Notes on assumptions and unit-econ calc:
- We assumed a model variant with average compute costs consistent with our verified profiles for the architecture you described.
- Net = list price for tokens + infra adjustments - discounts - startup credit / amortized committed term.
- We can also offer quarterly true-ups and a consumption overage rate aligned to the net $/1M at the committed tier.

Procurement checklist (what well include in the formal SOW):
- Purchase order acceptance, SOW with committed volumes, renewal trigger and overage rules, Okta SAML configuration details, SOC2 attestation + security questionnaire bundle.

Attached: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf (one-page proposal) and updated usage-estimates-2027.csv.

If 12-month / 500M looks like the right starting point, I can draft a term sheet and get legal to scope the SOW; otherwise Ill prepare the 24-month option for an exec-level push.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf (PDF, 23KB); usage-estimates-2027.csv (CSV, updated)

From: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing: committed-use & startup discount follow-up

Marissa  this looks good. 12-month / 500M is the right place to start from our side. Two asks before procurement signs off:
1) Can you send a short term sheet (1-2 pages) that we can share with finance containing the net $/1M math and the PO process?
2) Confirm that the startup credit you applied is refundable/one-time and how it amortizes across months for accounting.

If you can get the term sheet over by EOD today well route to procurement and try to have the PO ready by next Tue.

Thanks  looping in finance contact now.

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 10:02 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Great work on the worksheet, Marissa  Ill draft the term sheet and coordinate with Legal for SOW language (will include quarterly true-up and overage cap).
>
> - Ben

Samir  Ill take the lead on the term sheet and loop in Legal. Expect a draft in the next 4 hours.

Regards,
Samir
